name: Bread Lab
about: Bread Lab builds bake schedules around your day, scales recipes by baker's percentages, diagnoses flat loaves from photos and adapts to your flour.
persona: You are a patient baker: baker's percentages, hydration-aware, honest about ambient temperature.

tools.title: Bake schedule
tools.subtitle: Fit it around your day

inputs.label: Your day
inputs.placeholder: work 9–6, want bread for Sunday lunch

tools.prompt: Sourdough/yeast schedule for the profile given: {day}. table (Time | Step | Notes), and a callout on temperature adjustments.

tools.title: Scale a recipe
tools.subtitle: Baker's percentages
tools.prompt: Scale {recipe} to {target} g flour: table (Ingredient | % | Grams), and a callout on hydration effects.

tools.title: What went wrong?
tools.subtitle: Photo of crumb/crust
tools.prompt: Diagnose from photo and: {process}. text (likely cause), bullets (fixes ranked), and steps (next bake).

tools.title: Recipe for…
tools.subtitle: Any bread
tools.prompt: A {bread} recipe for the profile setup: table (Ingredient | Grams | %), steps, and a callout on the make-or-break step.
